context: Tatsuya-country mails a package of rice to his daughter; chats with Asuka.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: I'm sending this year's rice to my daughter.
lines.style: Soft, patient opening. Warm nostalgia colours the words. Quiet pride — not showy, just genuine. The pace of someone who has time and has learned its value.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Bright, certain affirmation. A teacher's voice — encouraging but not condescending. Genuine warmth. Lands the word 「絶対」with quiet conviction, like she knows this for sure.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: I pack it with care — with heart.
lines.style: Each phrase deliberately measured. Quiet reverence for the act. Slight pause after each image. The voice of someone for whom the work itself is the love.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 宅配、明日、来てくれるって。
lines.en: The delivery truck comes tomorrow, she said.
lines.style: Practical, informative tone. A gentle hand passing along good news. Slight lift at the end — anticipation, not urgency. The pleasure of confirmed plans.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: That's good. I'm looking forward to it.
lines.style: Satisfied contentment. Slower pace. The word 「楽しみ」settles like a warm sigh. No hurry. This quiet joy is enough.
